This bonus applies once to a city, and multiple copies of this building within 9 tiles of a city center do not provide additional bonuses. +1 [ICON_SCIENCE] Science to each coastal resource, Shipwreck, and Reef tile in this city. This building provides 2 slots of [ICON_GreatWork_Music] Music. +150% [ICON_Tourism] Tourism from [ICON_GreatWork_Music] Great Works of Music in this city.

Bakku bakku baku~n! Need something from Chloe?
Bakku bakku baku~n! I'm Sakamata Chloe, an orca, and the cleaner-slash-intern of Secret Society holoX.
There's a city of Chloe's pod nearby. Wanna stop by? …Oh, and don't peek into Chloe's room, okay?
Sure, sure! I've been kinda curious about your city. Got any good food?
Looks like we're pretty far apart. Wanna swap maps? Not sure you can read Chloe's handwriting, though.
Sorry, but you just made it onto Chloe's cleanup list. …Bakku bakku baku~n.
Huh? Picking on the new hire? …Fine. Chloe's really good at cleaning.
Noooo, come on… Chloe hasn't even sung enough yet!
Noooo, come on… Chloe hasn't even sung enough yet!
Hey, Chloe wants to be friends with you. …N-not that it means anything, okay!
Yay! Then we're friends starting today! …If you cheat on me, you're getting cleaned up, though, okay?
Huh… so you don't like me…? …Hmph. Fine, whatever.
Huh, you want to be friends with Chloe? Ugh, fine, if you insist~ I'll be nice to you!
Ohhh~? Aren't we a little early for that? We're not that close yet~
Hey, why not join Chloe's pod? Orcas hunt in packs, you know.
All right, now we're the same pod! Chloe'll watch your back.
Oh… so you're a lone orca, huh? Tell me anytime if you get lonely.
Sure! Chloe's more of a protect-others type than a be-protected type.
Hmm, it's a bit early to let you into the pod. Let Chloe watch how it goes a little longer, okay?
Heeey… isn't that kind of awful? Chloe's gonna tell everyone.
Huh, you hate Chloe…? …Hmph. If that's how you want it, I'm not holding back.
Your country's kinda nice! Chloe kinda likes it. …Just a little, though.
Watching what you've been up to lately is getting Chloe really irritated. …Be careful, okay?
Can Chloe send a delegation from her pod? They'll take a bath first, promise.
Thanks! Fish as a gift is fine, right?
Huh, no? …But I said they'd take a bath.
Sure, come on in! I'll show you around — anywhere but Chloe's room.
Sorry, it's kind of a mess right now… not exactly presentable.
Let Chloe set up an embassy over there. I'll send a cleaning person along, too.
Deal! I'll pick somewhere nice to live.
Heeey… why not~?
Sure. Don't make a mess… though Chloe's the last one who should say that.
Not yet. Chloe's secrets aren't something you get to peek at that easily.
Wanna open our borders so we can come and go freely?
Yay! Now Chloe can come visit anytime!
Hmph. Chloe's the type to hold a grudge, you know.
Sure~. But if you peek anywhere weird, I'll smack you, okay?
Nooo, no, no! I haven't forgiven you that much yet!
If it's about money, I'm all for it! Let's do it.
Ohhh~? Did you really think Chloe would nod at that?
So close! Let Chloe tweak this part a little? How about this?
Deal~! You get it, don't you?
Heeey… I thought it was a good offer, though~
…Hey, shall we wrap this up? Chloe's getting sleepy.
Yeah, that works. The cleanup ends here.
What? Shut up, seriously. As if I'd accept terms like that.
Whew… now I can finally get some proper sleep.
If that's how you want it, Chloe will clean you up all the way to the end.
…Fine, just this once. Chloe's the big sister, after all.
No, no, no! I'm never giving it to you!
That's what I like about you! …Just a little, though.
Hmph… Chloe remembers these things, you know?
That's Chloe's pod's territory, you know? If you get any closer… you get it, right?
Good, that's better. ♪
…Hmph. Then let's start by cleaning up the territory.
Huh, was it that close? Sorry, sorry — I'm bad at reading maps.
The sea doesn't belong to anybody, you know~?
Could you not teach my pod weird stuff?
Mm, thanks.
…I'm done with you. Chloe holds grudges, you know?
Okay~. …When you love something, you just can't help spreading it, you know?
Aw, but you want to spread good things, right? You'll get into it eventually, too.
Hey, could you stop digging up Chloe's land without asking?
Thanks. That's all I wanted you to understand.
Aw, you did it. …One more for the cleanup list.
Huh, that was your land? Sorry, I totally didn't notice…
It was buried, so it belongs to whoever finds it, right?
Could you stop sneaking around looking at me? That's Chloe's specialty, you know.
Good. Nice and honest.
Hmph. Then let's start by cleaning up your spies.
…Busted? Sorry, I won't do it again. …Probably.
You're saying that to a cleaner? Gathering intel is part of the job.
Hey, aren't you lining up too many troops on the border? Seeing that makes Chloe want to clean up.
Glad you understand. …You got lucky, huh?
Oh, sorry! They were only here to clean up the barbarians.
Wherever my kids are is Chloe's business, isn't it?
